items.title: Alvin Alcorn Interview, 1976-01-25
items.q: The interviewee discusses Sidney Bechet's life in Paris and his relationship with Louis Armstrong, but does not describe a personal interaction or professional connection with Bechet himself.

ctx.x: And when was this? 1956. 1956. First trip he made over there.

Louis had been over there for years. You know, going back and forth. Bechet was over there. All of them were glad to see us when we got over. Sidney Bechet? Oh yeah, he was living there. Where did he live?
